evals.prompt: My dashboard queries Spice every 2 seconds but the data only changes every minute. How do I set up caching so repeated queries are fast?
evals.expected_output: Configure sql_results cache with item_ttl of ~30-60s, maybe enable stale-while-revalidate

evals.prompt: I keep getting cache MISS responses even though I'm running the same query. What could be wrong?
evals.expected_output: Check item_ttl isn't too short, check cache_key_type (plan vs sql), check if dynamic functions like NOW() are used

assertions.name: mentions_ttl
assertions.description: Should mention TTL as a potential issue

evals.prompt: I want my API to never serve stale data but also not block on cold cache misses. Can I serve slightly old results while refreshing in the background?
evals.expected_output: Configure stale_while_revalidate_ttl for background refresh of stale entries
